tools.name: Beat Thief
tools.about: Turns any song into drum loops, bass, vocals and MIDI you can drop into Ableton.
needs: About 2GB of downloads for the instrument splitter (around 5 minutes)

tools.name: Ableton Loader
tools.about: Turns folders of multitrack recordings off the mixer into a finished Ableton project.
needs: Private: needs an invite from Stefan (a free GitHub account)

tools.name: Session Sync
tools.about: Shares an Ableton project between bandmates through Google Drive: pull, work, push.

tools.name: Movie Maker
tools.about: Finds the songs in a band recording and prepares the edit for Final Cut.
needs: Final Cut Pro to finish the edit
Shows without separate instrument tracks use the song splitter (about 2GB, installed with Beat Thief)
Private: needs an invite from Stefan (a free GitHub account)

tools.name: Stage Lighting
tools.about: Runs the stage lights from this computer and follows the music.
needs: Govee lights on your wifi and/or a USB DMX box
Private: needs an invite from Stefan (a free GitHub account)

tools.name: Video Streamer
tools.about: Films the show from phones and mixes it live: control room, guests filming, stream to the web.
needs: Android phones with the Video Streamer app
Private: needs an invite from Stefan (a free GitHub account)
